Candy Match 3.name: Candy Match 3
Candy Match 3.summary: Line up the sweets, set off tasty effects and beat the high scores!

Etrian Odyssey Untold - The Millennium G.name: Etrian Odyssey Untold: The Millennium Girl
Etrian Odyssey Untold - The Millennium G.summary:
Etrian Odyssey Untold: The Millennium Girl is the first in the Untold series which are to be remakes of the original Etrian Odyssey games. The games are first person RPG dungeon crawlers where you create a map of the labyrinth as you explore and complete quests.

The game features two game modes. The new story mode, has a pre-made party with a more in-depth story that has voice acting and animated cutscenes, and an enhanced classic mode, customize a party of 5 from 9 classes to explore the Yggdrasil labyrinth.

The game allows for the save data from story mode to be carried over to the classic mode once completed.

Jet Dog.name: Jet Dog
Jet Dog.summary: Send your dog flying as far through the air as possible with a stroke of the Nintendo 3DS stylus and unlock the equipment that will let you beat all the distance records. A simple, quick, funny and extremely addictive game for the entire family.

Rabbids - Travel in Time 3D.name: Rabbids Travel in Time 3D
Rabbids - Travel in Time 3D.summary: Rabbids are bwaaack and this time they have an infallible plan: travel back in time and invade human history! Plunge into the past with the wacky Rabbids and revisit the greatest moments of history like the discovery of fire, the broken nose of the Sphinx or the legend of Arthur. Uncover how Rabbids wreaked havoc and changed the course of history...
